messages.content:
我是做小家电的外贸业务员，帮我回复这条阿里巴巴国际站的询盘，用买家的语言，尽量拿下订单：

Hello, I manage procurement for a 40-property hotel group in Florida. We plan to place one garment steamer in each guest room, about 3,200 units in total, delivered in two lots in Q1. Please quote FOB Ningbo by sea for 3,000+ units, and confirm whether the unit has ETL or UL. We normally pay by L/C at sight. Could you also send 2 samples to our Orlando office? Regards, Dana Whitfield, Procurement Manager

我们工厂和产品的资料如下，请按资料回复：
{
 "factory": {
  "name_zh": "甬江小家电（示例工厂）",

  "capacity_units_per_month": 20000,
  "standard_lead_time_days": 35,

   "L/C at sight"
  ],
  "sales_contact_role": "业务员",

   "可寄样：样品按出厂单价收费，国际运费由买家承担；量产订单可抵扣样品费",
   "可安排视频验厂（阿里国际站视频通话）",
   "彩盒可印买家 logo：1000 个以上免费，以下每个加收 USD 0.15，需买家提供矢量稿"
  ]
 },
 "product": {
  "id": "GS-12H",
  "name_zh": "手持挂烫机",
  "name_en": "Handheld Garment Steamer",
  "specs": {
   "water_tank_ml": 260,
   "power_w_us": 1200,
   "voltage_us": "120V 60Hz",
   "heat_up_s": "约 25 秒（工厂内部测试）",

    "vertical and horizontal steaming",

    "auto shut-off",
    "fabric brush included"
   ]
  },

  ],

  ],

 }

我的意图：报 3000 台以上阶梯价 10.90，L/C 即期可以；没有 ETL/UL，如实说明，可以评估办理；样品按资料里的样品政策。

content:
{"reply": "Dear Dana,

Thank you for your inquiry and for considering Yongjiang Small Appliances for your hotel group's garment steamer program. Here is our offer and the details you asked for.

1. Product: GS-12H Handheld Garment Steamer (US version)
- 120V 60Hz, 1200W
- 260 ml detachable water tank for easy refilling
- Vertical and horizontal steaming
- Auto shut-off
- Fabric brush included
- Steam ready in about 25 seconds (based on our internal factory testing)
- Packing: color box, 12 units per carton

2. Price
- FOB Ningbo, by sea, 3,000+ units: USD 10.90 per unit
- For reference, 800–2,999 units: USD 11.60 per unit
- Since your order exceeds 1,000 units, we can print your hotel group's logo on the color box free of charge. We will just need your logo as a vector file (AI/EPS/PDF).

3. Certifications (please read)
The GS-12H currently does NOT have UL or ETL certification. It currently holds:
- CB report (IEC 60335-2-3)
- CE (LVD/EMC)
We understand that UL or ETL listing is often required for products placed in US hotel guest rooms. If it is a requirement for your project, we are willing to evaluate obtaining ETL or UL certification for this model. We would need to confirm the cost and timeline with the testing lab before committing to any date. Please let us know whether ETL/UL is mandatory for you, and we will come back with a concrete assessment.

4. Payment terms
L/C at sight is acceptable to us. We also accept 30% T/T deposit with 70% against B/L copy, if that is ever more convenient for you.

5. Lead time and delivery in two lots
- Our standard lead time is 35 days.
- Our capacity is about 20,000 units per month, so 3,200 units split into two lots is well within our capacity.
- Please share your preferred quantity and target ship date for each lot in Q1, and we will plan production around them.
- Note: if ETL/UL certification is required, the shipping schedule would depend on the certification timeline. We would confirm this with you before finalizing dates.

6. Samples to your Orlando office
We are glad to send 2 samples. Our sample policy is:
- Samples are charged at our factory unit price.
- International courier cost is paid by the buyer.
- The sample charge will be credited against your bulk order.
If you have a courier account (DHL/FedEx/UPS), please send us the account number and your Orlando delivery address. Otherwise, we can quote the shipping cost for you. Please note the samples are our current production model, which is not UL/ETL certified at this time.

7. Factory verification
If helpful, we can arrange a live video factory tour via Alibaba video call, so your team can see our production lines and quality control.

To move forward, could you please confirm:
(a) whether ETL or UL is mandatory for your properties;
(b) the quantity and timing for each of the two lots;
(c) your courier account and address for the samples;
(d) whether you would like your logo printed on the color box.

We look forward to supporting your hotel group on this project.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Sales Representative
Yongjiang Small Appliances
Ningbo, China"}
